mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (id, user_id, token_hash, family_id, client, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{familyId}, #{client}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{at} WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{at} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
